items.title: Coastal states enter the last night of fishing quota talks
items.summary: Delegates say a shared catch ledger is within reach, though two states still want a longer phase-in.

items.title: Rail tunnel completes its last test run before opening
items.summary: Engineers signed off on ventilation and signalling after a full-length run at line speed.

items.title: Warehouses in the valley add 600 seasonal jobs
items.summary: Employers are offering signing bonuses for night shifts as the port's busiest stretch begins.

items.title: Amateur astronomer spots a faint comet from the river path
items.summary: The object, confirmed by the hilltop observatory, is expected to brighten over the next fortnight.

items.title: Inspectors sign off on the new Northgate Bridge deck
items.summary: With the load test passed, the city says the bridge could reopen to walkers and cyclists within days.

items.title: School board delays a vote on new attendance boundaries
items.summary: Parents asked for more time to review maps that would move about 140 students between two elementary schools.

items.title: Winter market vendors tour the old tram depot
items.summary: The market association says heating and lighting are ready for a move this weekend.

items.title: The bridge repairs were worth the wait
items.summary: Two years of detours bought a crossing that should last another century.
items.stance: Doing the repair properly beat doing it fast.
